Phoenix’s transfer rules

  • At least 36 semester credits must be completed at Phoenix.

Questions

Which courses must I take at University of Phoenix?

In this plan, 36 semester credits are taken at Phoenix, including MHACB 505 Systems Thinking in Health Care Environments, MHACB 506 Ethical Marketing: The New Health Care Economics, MHACB 507 Leveraging Informatics in the Health Sector, MHACB 508 Navigating the Regulatory Environment in Health Care, MHACB 598 Leveraging Results to Build Brand in The Health Sector and MHACB 515 Scanning the Health Sector as an Industry Expert and 6 more. Phoenix requires at least 36 semester credits at Phoenix.

Has University of Phoenix confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Phoenix’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Phoenix’s decisions.
